ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (approx. 90-95%) forming a dark-gray/black base, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 5-10% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across the majority of the fluke. Distinct high-contrast white geometric blobs are concentrated at the far-left and far-right distal tips, with sparse, small-scale white point-clusters scattered across the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley pixel amplitude observed on the interior-left lobe and the terminal-right lobe section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into a sharper upward vertical vector toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel rosettes detected at the distal tips of both lobes; several isolated circular white clusters present in the central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the mid-section of the right lobe; isolated thin linear scratches detected on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and colonization by sessile organisms (barnacles) localized at both fluke tips; multiple circular white depressions (likely lamprey or predator bite scars) visible on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique annular (ring-shaped) white scar pattern located in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
